answer: Savings realized through Summa Health's participation in the 340B Drug Pricing Program helped preserve and strengthen services that were important to the health of the communities we served. These resources provided additional financial capacity to care for patients who may have had difficulty obtaining needed healthcare because of limited income, inadequate insurance coverage, or other medical and social challenges. The benefit of the 340B program extended beyond medication costs. Savings helped Summa sustain services such as our Complex Care Clinic, Senior Health Clinic, and behavioral health programs, including psychiatric and addiction services. These programs provided important access points for patients whose healthcare needs required ongoing clinical management, coordination among multiple providers, or additional support outside of a traditional office visit.Summa also worked to identify and address non-medical circumstances that could interfere with a patient's ability to successfully receive care. Community outreach and patient support efforts helped address needs such as transportation, access to medications, coordination of healthcare services, and connections to appropriate social resources. Addressing these challenges helped patients remain engaged in their treatment, take medications as prescribed, and receive appropriate care earlier in the course of an illness. The financial resources made available through 340B also supported Summa's ability to provide charity care, medication assistance, and free or reduced-cost services to patients who otherwise may have had difficulty accessing them. These efforts were particularly important for uninsured and underinsured individuals and others facing significant barriers to healthcare. Ultimately, the 340B program helped Summa direct healthcare resources toward areas of significant community need. The savings generated through the program strengthened our ability to maintain essential services, support vulnerable patient populations, and improve access to coordinated care. This reinvestment supported Summa's broader mission of improving the health of the communities we served while helping reduce disparities in access to healthcare and treatment.
